description: Implementation of the AdbWinUsbInterfaceObject class, which manages USB interface interactions via WinUsb API, including handle creation, descriptor retrieval, endpoint management, and serial number fetching.

classes.name: AdbWinUsbInterfaceObject
classes.description: Class encapsulating USB interface operations using WinUsb API, including handle management, descriptor caching, endpoint configuration, and serial number retrieval.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Opens USB device handle, initializes WinUsb, caches descriptors and interface info, and sets up bulk endpoints.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Releases WinUsb handle and closes device handle.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number string from the USB device, converting to ANSI or wide char as requested.

methods.name: GetEndpointInformation
methods.description: Fetches details about a specified endpoint, including type, size, and polling interval.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint
methods.description: Opens a specific endpoint by index or ID with specified access and sharing modes.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint (overload)
methods.description: Creates an endpoint object and returns its handle.
